}}'''Allan M. Ramsay''' is a [[Professor]] of [[Formal Linguistics]] in the [[Department of Computer Science, University of Manchester|Department of Computer Science]] at the [[University of Manchester]].<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.manchester.ac.uk/research/Allan.ramsay/ |title=Prof Allan Ramsay (BSc, MSc, PhD), research profile - personal details (The University of Manchester) |access-date=2012-06-10}}</ref><ref name="scopus">{{Scopus}}</ref><ref>{{Cite journal | doi = 10.1023/B:AIRE.0000045504.76256.0d| title = Sarcasm, Deception, and Stating the Obvious: Planning Dialogue without Speech Acts| journal = Artificial Intelligence Review| volume = 22| issue = 2| pages = 149–171| year = 2004| s2cid = 30441639| last1 = Deborafield| last2 = Allanramsay}}</ref><ref>{{Cite book | doi = 10.1109/STAIR.2011.5995796| chapter = Evaluation of dependency parsers for long Arabic sentences| title = 2011 International Conference on Semantic Technology and Information Retrieval| pages = 243| year = 2011| last1 = Alabbas | first1 = M. | last2 = Ramsay | first2 = A. | isbn = 978-1-61284-354-4| s2cid = 17112997}}</ref><ref name="doi10.1016/j.csl.2007.06.004|noedit">{{Cite journal | last1 = Ramsay | first1 = A. | author-link1 = Allan M. Ramsay| last2 = Mansour | first2 = H. | doi = 10.1016/j.csl.2007.06.004 | title = Towards including prosody in a text-to-speech system for modern standard Arabic | journal = Computer Speech & Language | volume = 22 | pages = 84–103 | year = 2008 }}</ref>

==Education==
Ramsay's undergraduate degree was in [[Logic]] and [[Mathematics]] from the [[University of Sussex]].<ref>{{Cite journal | doi = 10.1007/BF00142289| title = What we say and what we mean| journal = Artificial Intelligence Review| volume = 1| issue = 3| pages = 139–157| year = 1987| last1 = Ramsay | first1 = A.| s2cid = 23014507}}</ref> After completing a [[Master of Science]] degree in Logic from the [[University of London]], he returned to Sussex to complete a [[PhD]] in [[Artificial Intelligence]]. Prior to working at [[University of Manchester Institute of Science and Technology|UMIST]] and the [[University of Manchester]], he was Professor of [[Artificial Intelligence]] at [[University College Dublin]].

==Research==
Ramsay's research<ref name="DBLP">{{DBLP|name=Allan Ramsay}}</ref><ref name="ACM">{{ACMPortal}}</ref> focuses on [[Natural language processing]],<ref>{{Cite journal | last1 = Ramsay | first1 = A. | author-link = Allan M. Ramsay| title = Generating relevant models | doi = 10.1007/BF00249019 | journal = Journal of Automated Reasoning | volume = 7 | issue = 3 | pages = 359–368 | year = 1991 | s2cid = 38135904 }}</ref><ref>{{Cite journal | last1 = Ramsay | first1 = A. | author-link1 = Allan M. Ramsay| title = Appelt, D.E.Planning English Sentences | doi = 10.1207/s15516709cog1203_5 | journal = Cognitive Science | volume = 12 | issue = 3 | pages = 467–477 | year = 1988 | doi-access = free }}</ref><ref name="POP11">{{cite book |author1=Sloman, Aaron |author2=Barrett, Rosalind |author3=Ramsay, Allan |title=POP-11: a practical language for artificial intelligence |publisher=E. Horwood |location=Chichester |year=1985 |isbn=0-470-20237-8 }}</ref><ref name="fmai">{{cite book |author =Ramsay, Allan |title=Formal methods in artificial intelligence |publisher=Cambridge University Press |location=Cambridge, UK |year=1988 |isbn=0-521-42421-6 }}</ref> including [[Morphology (linguistics)|morphology]] and [[syntax]]. He has published papers on the analysis of free [[word order]] languages, particularly morphology of the [[Arabic language]],<ref name="doi10.1016/j.csl.2007.06.004|noedit"/><ref>{{Cite book | last1 = Ramsay | first1 = A. | author-link1 = Allan M. Ramsay| last2 = Mansour | first2 = H. | chapter = Local Constraints on Arabic Word Order | doi = 10.1007/11816508_45 | title = Advances in Natural Language Processing | series = Lecture Notes in Computer Science | volume = 4139 | pages = 447 | year = 2006 | isbn = 978-3-540-37334-6 }}</ref> which poses a number of specific problems. Some of this research has been funded by the [[Engineering and Physical Sciences Research Council|EPSRC]].<ref>http://gow.epsrc.ac.uk/NGBOViewPerson.aspx?PersonId=47856 {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140416183429/http://gow.epsrc.ac.uk/NGBOViewPerson.aspx?PersonId=47856 |date=16 April 2014 }} Grants awarded to Allan Ramsay by the [[Engineering and Physical Sciences Research Council]]</ref>
